I am super excited to finally announce the big update I've been working on since January. It is almost 100 days of work[i] (most of you know, I worked on this practically every day of the week)[/i]! If you have not been playing the Testing branch, this is going to be an excellent surprise for you 💦💦💦

First things first, thank you to everyone who joined[b] [url=https://discord.gg/CdM5ywGYKU]Discord [/url][/b]and took the time to report issues, give ideas, and talk with me about what they had in mind in general. It makes a huge difference in the game, and that means so much to me!

[h1]Quick summary?
60+ New content
300+ Improvements & fixes[/h1]
(All of that is only possible because people keep joining [b] [url=https://discord.gg/CdM5ywGYKU]Discord [/url][/b] and report me issues and suggest new content)

[h1]Highlight news![/h1]

[h3]New voice for all characters! Stepmom, Stepsister, Main Character![/h3]

Hard to picture this right ahah, but the Voice Actor and Voice Actress did an incredible job! They are super reliable and will continue to work with us for future chapters and projects 🥰

[h3]Progression with Stepmom![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/6fbaea0c0159514f23e7ef1210d84e1079e5cd3d.png[/img]
Stepmom has now progressed to unlock in 6 chapters. From asking her to follow you, doing laundry to distract her, to kisses and more! As some of you know, the next chapter will be fully dedicated to her and will have more progression to unlock.

Progression also means that all chapters affected by this now have dialogue options that give more content and opportunity to replay and have a different ending for the chapter in question.

[h3]Steam Workshop for Girl Creator![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/cecb06fd6e6c6d8752a7432917058940f98759c6.png[/img]
Here it is! People have shared over 250+ girls, and I am sure it will go over 1000 quite fast. Thank you for being creative and pushing the limit!

[h3]Task system![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/06b75109d47c2c7f6cfc865aac23798e2ff560c1.png[/img]
The task system will be the core of the Life Cycle. Right now, it has been used a lot to replace more complex steps in the chapter. It essentially allow me to create more action without having to enter as much data, but also will make it more easy to translate these from any chapter directly to the Life Cycle!

The Life Cycle will be my main focus after the next chapter (which the next chapter will be my main focus after this Major Update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/de93adb935608a5989e60fe8dab7d1a4f73b4aa5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982264/0de585aca8c64a20659cbd180ed281ed5663e0e4.png[/img]
